note: No models are bundled. Every entry is a user-initiated HTTPS download pinned by exact size and SHA-256. Installation registers the model inactive; activation is a separate explicit step.

models.name: Whisper Medium Q5_0
models.notes: 769M-parameter multilingual Whisper medium, Q5_0 ggml container. Balanced CPU quality/memory. Languages are read from the loaded model, not a fixed fa/en list.

models.name: Whisper Large v3 Turbo Q5_0
models.notes: 809M-parameter large-v3-turbo, Q5_0 ggml container. Faster decoder aimed at higher speech quality. Languages are model-derived.

models.name: Qwen2.5 3B Instruct Q4_K_M
models.notes: 3.09B neural instruction model in GGUF Q4_K_M. Runs in the isolated OpenSpeechWorker process. 8 GB RAM minimum recommended; long text is chunked and incomplete output fails instead of being saved.

models.name: fastText LID 176 (full)
models.notes: Full 176-label supervised language classifier (.bin, not the reduced/quantized .ftz). Used for auto-detection before translation.
